protocol.score: Free Brier minus selected Brier minus actual virtual price, including failed delivery

protocol.controls: Shared latent opportunity stream and delayed feedback; no neural features, RPC, signing or real money

scope: Synthetic statistical resource-selection results; not paid purchases, neural advantage or evidence of consciousness
